title: fix(plugin-detail): the derived highlight strip skips members of a field group gated by visibleWhen (objectui#12720)
body:
Fixes #12720
Clause-②: no

The derived strip stops picking members of a field group whose `visibleWhen` the details body evaluates. No node prop or package export is added: the new helper is private to `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`.

## What

When an object declares no `highlightFields`, `deriveHighlightFields` picks the header chips heuristically, and it never read `fieldGroups`. A member of a gated group could therefore become a chip with its value on a record where the details body hides the whole group (objectui#11630). Card reproduction: `Dev Admin · Basic plan · only-for-pro` on a `kind = basic` record.

The heuristic now skips every member of a group that declares a `visibleWhen`, in both the preferred-name pass and the type-filter pass. They are skipped after the retired-type check, so the objectui#4914 report fires exactly as before.

## Why this shape (card option a)

- The derivation runs from object metadata with no record in hand, so it can only ask whether a member's group is gated, never what the gate answers.
- Which members count as gated comes from `deriveFieldGroupDetailEntries`, the derivation the body's `resolveSectionGroup` resolves `{ group }` references against, using that gate's own test (`entry.visibleWhen != null`). A blank `visibleWhen`, which the shared derivation drops and the body never gates, does not gate the strip either. The predicate is not copied: the body's `resolveFieldRuleState` call stays the only evaluator.
- Option (b), evaluating per record in `record-highlights.tsx`, was measured. The renderer can read `fieldGroups` from the record context's object schema, so it needs no new node prop. But it cannot tell a derived `fields` list from a declared or hand-authored one, so it would also gate declared `highlightFields` and hand-authored strips, which this card leaves to the author.

## What the page does now

- Group hidden (`kind = basic`): the member is in neither the strip nor the body.
- Group shown (`kind = pro`): the member is not a chip. It is drawn once, in the body's group section. A skipped member is not in the strip's list, so it is not in the body's `hideFields` either.
- Predicate faulted: the body shows the group, as the form does. The strip still skips the member, so it appears once.
- The app-shell record preview card's key fields come from the same heuristic and skip those members too.

## Tests

- `synth/__tests__/deriveHighlightFields.groupGate-12720.test.ts`: the card shape; a control with no `visibleWhen`; the envelope spelling; a blank `visibleWhen`; the preferred-name pass; a declared list left unchanged; the synthesized page's strip `fields` and body `hideFields`.
- `renderers/__tests__/record-highlights.groupGate-12720.test.tsx`: the synthesized `record:highlights` and `record:details` rendered on one record context and one highlight registry. It counts the member's value across the whole page for basic, pro and a faulted predicate, with harness-dead guards on both regions.
- Ablation: replacing the gated set with an empty set fails 7 of the 10 tests. The 3 that still pass are the controls that do not depend on the gate. Restored blob equals HEAD.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail` passed: 279 files, 2678 tests. The other 40 test files naming these symbols passed: 1860 tests. Type-check, the changeset gates and eslint are clean.

## Live reading

Showcase backend from published `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.2 (`e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`), console dev server from this branch, the card's steps 1 to 5 plus a `pro` row, 2 loads each, screenshot before every DOM read. Before (same server, fix line ablated): `Dev Admin · Basic plan · only-for-pro`. After: `Dev Admin · Basic plan` on basic, and on pro `Dev Admin · Pro plan` with the Pro details section in the body holding the value once. Screenshots and readings: branch `claude/issue-12720-evidence`, folder `evidence/12720/`.

## Acceptance notes

- Declared `highlightFields` (out of scope, the author's call): a declared entry inside a gated group is unchanged. It is a chip on every record, and the body leaves it out of its grid, so when the predicate is false its value appears only in the strip.
